split_policy.TUCC: Frames of the 105 convex-probe clips listed in external/ultrasound-augmentation/usaugment-experiments/scripts/data/thyroid_ultrasound_cineclip/patients.csv (the clip selection of Tupper and Gagne). Clip-level GroupShuffleSplit: 20 percent of clips to test, then 10 percent of the remaining clips to validation, random_state 42 in both steps; 75/9/21 clips.
split_policy.TN3K: Released test set kept as test. Released trainval images split by image: group ids sorted, shuffled with random.Random(0), 20 percent to validation.
split_policy.DDTI: Case-level three-way split: case ids sorted, shuffled with random.Random(0), 20 percent of cases to test, next 20 percent to validation, rest to training. All panels of a case stay in one partition.

duplicate_policy: Keep all source rows and known duplicate images; no hash grouping or deduplication.
